precepts.text: In that day Israel praises Him; the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my salvation, and great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee, the same God.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

precepts.why:
“Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength”. The Lord has many names, and Jehovah is one of them. Isaiah 12 is the same song: “Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.” Then: “Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.”

The Lord Jehovah and the Holy One of Israel are the same God. That is how one answers a Jehovah’s Witness: Jehovah is the Holy One of Israel. In that day Israel praises Him, His anger turned away, and He brings down them that dwell on high, the lofty cities of the nations, so that the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy tread them down.

points: In that day you shall say, "O Lord, I will praise Thee; though Thou wast angry with me, Thine anger is turned away, and Thou comfortedst me."

points: "Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid, for the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song; He also is become my salvation." With joy shall you draw water out of the wells of salvation.

note.label: Isaiah 12: Salvation, Joy, and the Holy One of Israel

points: In that day you shall praise the Most High, call upon His name, declare His doings among the people, and make mention that His name is exalted. Sing unto the Most High, for He has done excellent things known in all the earth.

note.label: Isaiah 12: Salvation, Joy, and the Holy One of Israel

points: Cry out and shout, inhabitant of Zion, for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee. Verse 2 calls Him Jehovah, and verse 6 calls Him the Holy One of Israel; in context they are the same God.

Jehovah's witnesses say "say the name, say Jehovah." Right here in the scriptures the Holy One of Israel and Jehovah are shown to be the same God. This is how to keep it in context with the scriptures.
